hero.oneLiner: Equitas Small Finance Bank positions itself under the theme "From Resilience to Momentum" as a secured-heavy, multi-product small finance bank deliberately capping its microfinance exposure at around 10% of advances while scaling SBL, vehicle, housing, MSE, NBFC and gold lending on a granular retail deposit franchise.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Presence across 16 States and 2 UTs with 1063 Banking Outlets, 396 ATMs (394 onsite and 4 offsite), 366 Business Correspondents and 27,720 employees.
- Geographically concentrated in the south: Tamil Nadu & Pondicherry account for 44.37% of advances and 24.45% of deposits, followed by Maharashtra (15.45% / 19.55%) and Karnataka (12.33% / 7.15%); Tamil Nadu alone has 347 branches.
- Journey slide traces the franchise from Microfinance (2007), Vehicle Finance (2011), Small Business Loans (2013), SFB operations after final RBI approval (2016), MSE Finance (2018), IPO and listing (2020), Affordable Housing Finance and Used Car Loans (2021), FNCR Deposits & Inward Remittances (2025) to Credit Card (2026).
- Deck states the Bank's CD programme has the highest rating at A1+ from India Ratings, CareEdge Ratings & CRISIL, and both the issuer rating and Tier-II Bond are rated AA-/Stable by India Ratings & CareEdge Ratings.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Shareholders funds position: CRAR 19.44% with Tier I at 16.01% and Tier II at 3.43%.
- Networth of Rs. 6,367 Cr as at Jun-26 (Capital 1,144 and Reserves & Surplus 5,223), stated as 9% YoY and 4% QoQ growth.
- Funding mix at Q1FY27 is CASA 21%, TD* 63%, Refinance 10%, Tier-II Bond 2%, Securitisation/Assignment 2% and IBPC 2% (*includes Certificate of Deposits), with total book value of Rs. 57,823 Crore.
- CD ratio at 92.93% in Q1FY27 versus 93.65% in Q4FY26; after reducing refinance borrowings from advances it stands at 81.25% versus 83.40% in Q4FY26. Liquidity Coverage Ratio as on 30.06.2026 is 178.46%.
- Total net investment portfolio of Rs. 9,870 Crore comprising SLR Rs. 9,357 Crore and Non-SLR Rs. 513 Crore.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Provisioning policy] The Bank applies provisioning materially stricter than IRAC — e.g. sub-standard unsecured at 96% versus 25% under IRAC, sub-standard secured 28% versus 15%, and doubtful-1 secured 79% versus 25%.
- [Provisioning strengthening] Deck notes the Bank further strengthened provisioning norms leading to additional provisions of ~Rs. 145 Crore and one-time additional stress-sector provisioning of ~Rs. 185 Crore proactively on standard assets for MFI.
- [Accounting/methodology change] Effective Q1FY27, NIM is represented on daily average interest-earning assets, replacing the earlier methodology based on the average of opening and closing interest-earning assets; prior-period NIMs have been restated for comparability. Under the earlier methodology Q1FY27 NIM would be 7.07% versus 7.24% on the daily average basis.
- [Management change] Mr. Mukund Shyamrao Barsagade appointed Chief Financial Officer (KMP) effective 1st July 2026; Mr. Taraka Ramana Prathipati appointed Interim Chief Risk Officer (SMP) effective 1st July 2026.
- [Regulatory/labour] Cost to Income slide references a one-time incremental provision of Rs. 29.52 Crore due to implementation of the new labour code.
